content: Ganchis discïpuluncunata Jesucristo yuripashgan
Tsaypitanami Tiberias
nishgan lagüna cuchuncho Jesús yapay discïpuluncunata yuripargan.

Tsay lagüna cuchunchömi caycargan Simón Pedro, Milïshu nishgan Tomás y Natanaelpis. Natanaelga cargan Galilea provinciacho Caná marcapitami. Zebedeupa ishcan tsurincuna más ishcay discípulu mayincunapis tsaychömi carcaycargan.

Tsaymi Simón Pedro caynog nergan: “Pescädo tsaregmi aywaycä.” Tsaynog niptinmi discípulu mayincuna nergan: “Nogacunatapis yanapanäpag pushaycalämay.” Tsauraga büquiman witsarcur lapan aywargan. Tsay tsacay waraylata pescacuycarpis manami ni juc pescädulatapis tsaripäcorgantsu.
Patsa waraycaptinnami discïpulucuna ricargan juc runa lagüna cuchuncho caycagta. Itsanga manami musyapäcorgantsu Jesús cashganta.
Paymi caynog gayacorgan: “¿Naganacu pescäduta tsaripäcushcanqui?” Tsauraga discïpulucuna caynog nergan: “Manami ni juclaylatapis tsaripäcöragtsu, tayta.”

Tsaymi Jesús discïpulucunata caynog nergan: “Redniquita mashtapäcuy büquipa derëcha cag lädunman. Tsaypitami pescäduta tsaripäcamunquipag.” Nishgannog redta mashtarnami tsaripäcorgan tsaytsica pescäduta, hasta tsutaytapis mana puëdishganyag.

Tsauraga cuyashgan cag discïpulun Jesús cashganta reguiycur Pedruta caynog nergan: “¡Payga Jesusmi!” Tsaynog niptinmi jorgushgan cag röpanta jaticurcur Simón Pedro jucla Jesús cagman nadyaypa aywargan.
Waquin cag discïpuluncunami itsanga büquiwan aywapäcorgan. Lagüna cuchunpita pachac (100) metrunogla captinmi red junta pescäduta yacu cuchunman garachapäcorgan.
Tsayman chayarnami redta cachaycur büquipita yargapäcorgan. Tsaychömi taripäcorgan shansha janancho pescädo cancashga caycagta y tantatapis.
Tsauraga Jesús caynog nergan: “Tsay tsaripäcamushgayqui pescäduta juc ishcayta apamuy cancanantsipag.”

Tsaynog niptinmi Simón Pedro büquiman witsarcur redta garachamorgan pescäducunata shuntapäcunanpag. Tsay redchöga cargan pachac pitsga chunca quimsa (153) jatusag pescäducunami. Tsaytsica pescädo caycaptinpis red manami rachergantsu.
Tsauraga Jesús nergan: “Micunantsipag shapäcamuyna.” Jesús cashganta musyarmi maygan discïpulunpis mana tapupargantsu pï cashgantapis.
Jesús cashgan cagman chayaptinnami tantata y pescäduta paycunata ayporgan.
Tsaywanga quimsa cutinami discïpuluncunata Jesús yuripargan.
Simón Pedruwan Jesucristo parlashgan

Micuyta usharcurnami Jesús taporgan Simón Pedruta caynog nir: “Jonaspa tsurin Pedro, ¿lapanpitapis mascu gam cuyamanqui?” Tsaynog tapuptin Pedro nergan: “Au tayta, gam musyanquimi cuyashgäta.” Tsauraga Jesús nergan: “Tsaynog carga mitsicog runa uyshancunata ricashgannog nogaman yäracamagcunata shumag ricanqui.”

Jesús yapay taporgan Simón Pedruta: “Jonaspa tsurin Simón, ¿gam cuyamanquicu?” Tsaynog tapuptin Pedro nergan: “Au tayta, gam musyanquimi cuyashgäta.” Niptinmi nergan: “Tsaynog carga mitsicog runa uyshancunata ricashgannog nogaman yäracamagcunata shumag ricanqui.”

Tsaypita Jesús yapay taporgan Simón Pedruta: “Jonaspa tsurin Simón, ¿gam rasunpacu cuyamanqui?” Quimsa cuti Jesús tsaynogla tapuptinmi Pedro laquishga nergan: “Gam lapantapis musyanquimi, tayta. Tsaynogpis musyanquimi gamta cuyashgäta.” Niptinmi Jesús nergan: “Tsauraga mitsicog runa uyshancunata ricashgannog nogaman yäracamagcunata shumag ricanqui.

Mözularag carga quiquilayquimi röpayquita jaticorgayqui maypapis munashgayquipa aywanayquipag. Auquinna captiquinami itsanga ricrayquita mashtarcuptiqui jucna röpayquita jatipäshunquipag. Tsaynogpis aywayta mana munashgayquipami apashunquipag.”
Tsaynog nirmi Jesús tantyatsergan payman yäracushganpita Pedro crucificaypa wanutsishga cananpag cashganta. Nircurnami Pedruta caynog nergan: “Nishgäcunata imaypis cumpliy.”
Libro ushanan

Tsaypitanami Pedro ticrarcamur Jesús cuyashgan cag discïpulunta ricargan pay cagman aywaycagta. Payta ricärirmi Jesusta caynog taporgan: “Tayta, paytaga ¿imatag pasanga?” (Manarag Jesús wanuptinmi cuyashgan discïpulun naupalancho micorgan. Tsaychömi payta taporgan maygan discïpulun contran sharcunanpag cashgantapis.)
Pedro tsaynog tapuptinmi Jesús nergan: “¿Imanirtag paypag tapuycämanqui? Cutimunäyag cawanan captinpis gamga nishgäcunata lapanta cumpliy.”

Tsaynog niptinmi waquin discïpulucuna yarpapäcorgan tsay cuyashgan discïpulun imaypis mana wanunanpag cashganta. Tsaynog yarpapäcuptinpis Jesusga manami mana wanunanpag cashgantatsu nergan, sinöga: “Cutimunäyag cawanan captinpis ¿imanirtag paypag tapuycämanqui?” nergan.
Jesuspa cuyashgan discïpulun carmi caycunata escribishcä. Lapan escribishgäcunaga rasun caglami caycan.
Jesús rurashgancunaga cay escribishgäcunapitapis masragmi caycan. Lapan rurashgancunata escriberga manami imaypis ushämantsu cargan. [Amén.]

footnotes.text: Tiberias nishgan lagünaga Galilea lagünami caycan.
